programmes.d: Head to Italy to drive the mighty Pagani Huayra and get a taste of the Veyron Vitesse. Then, a proper Ferrari?
Jethro investigates whether or not Ferrari has created another masterpiece. Then, an epic road trip.
The evo team returns to northern Scotland with eight of 2021's very best performance cars. Only one will win.
Compare the Audi RS 3, Toyota GR Yaris and AMG A45 S in a four-wheel hatch showdown!
Witness a Porsche 911 GT3 speed test then a V12 showdown!
Car reviews: McLaren 570S Spider, Eagle Low Drag GT, Porsche Cayman GTS and Alfa Giulia Quadrifoglio.
The Porsche 911 4S tops 2S in the rain. Then, the Mini JCW GP take on the Audi A1 and Focus RS500 on track.

Bill needs Dan to tame a 1969 Pontiac Firebird that was set-up for just one thing – speed. Tim’s 1974 International Harvester Scout was given a paint job that took 4 years. He hopes that Dan can somehow pick up the pieces. Literally.
Steve has only driven his prized 1969 Camaro Z28 at five miles an hour, but he wants it to be a muscle car beast. Scott owns a rare matching numbers 1964 Corvette that he wants brought back to life.

Walter loves the fast and futuristic look of his 1975 Bricklin. Unfortunately, the car drives like something from the dark ages. Dan restores a 1963 Split Window Corvette for a pair of owners who know him well – his Uncle Carl and Aunt Claire.
Charles wants Dan to find him a 1967 Corvette with a set-up that’s rare as hen’s teeth. Bob’s 1973 Cuda has been stored for most of its life – but even in storage time takes a heavy toll.
FantomWorks dull the fangs on a 1965 Shelby Cobra kit car and bring a 1964 Dodge Dart back on target.

Patsy and Apryle bring their 1968 Corvette in for mechanical work, but what their car really needs is a new paint job. Jim’s 1958 Impala is an auction car. It looks pretty but when it’s time to drive – it’s half the car Jim was hoping for.
Chris wants the 1950 F1 Truck he remembers from high school and Dean wants the 1968 Lincoln Continental he drove with his dad.

Bob spent years working on his beloved 1969 K20 Truck, but he needs FantomWorks to solve the mysteries within. Dan’s brother-in-law John shows up with a 1962 Ferrari kit car that looks hot, but the wiring could burn it to the ground.
It's all hands on deck when Danny and the guys get to work transforming a 1960 Volkswagen Bus into a high end luxury beach cruiser. But an unexpected hiccup threatens to derail the whole project.

Danny is commissioned to custom paint a brand new pick-up for a charity auction for the local YMCA. But Danny can't stop at paint, he adds the ultimate accessory a matching chopper that fits in the back.
Brann Dailor, drummer for the Grammy-winning heavy metal band Mastodon, brings in his 1970 Cadillac Coupe DeVille for some much needed Counts Kustoms love.
Vegas Golden Knights goalie Marc-Andre Fleury comes to Count's Kustoms looking for an All-American muscle car fit for a three-time Stanley Cup champion.

Danny has big plans for a little street rocket known as a Manta, and the crew commissions an 80s era Corvette that the owner wants to bring into the new millennium. Shannon meets a motorcycle racer who wants her Harley XR1200 customized.
The massive auto extravaganza known as SEMA is rolling into Las Vegas, and this time Danny will be ready. He's getting not one, but two incredible Counts Kustoms creations ready for the big show.
Danny Koker restores a 1969 Shelby GT500 numbers-matching car from a rust bucket into an instant classic. The team visits the Detroit Autorama.
The R8 V10 Plus beats the 911 Turbo S in wet conditions. Then, Audi TT Cup challenges.
Watch the McLaren 750S take on the Ferrari 296 GTB. Then, enjoy a review of Ariel Atom 3.5R.
The Ferrari 488 Pista excels at Anglesey. Then, review the features of the Bugatti Chiron.
Porsche, Rimac and Maserati thrill with innovation. Then, review the 919 Hybrid at the Geneva Motor Show.
Travel to Nice in the SLS Roadster. Then, review a turbo car lineup and Ferrari's 2016 Paris Motor Show.
In this track showdown, GT2 RS wins over SLS and F-Type wins over Street Triple.
The Hyundai i30 N takes on Honda Civic Type R in this track showdown.
Join the Mk2 Escort at the Woodpecker Rally then a track battle between the McLaren P1 and Porsche 918 Spyder.
evo's Editorial Director, Harry Metcalfe, drives the 2012 Mille Miglia in a 1955 Alfa 1900 SS across Italy.
Watch the showdown between the Porsche GT3 RS, McLaren 750S and Radical SR3 XXR.
Review the McLaren 675LT and Proteus C-Type. Then, compare the Renaultsport Megane against Honda Civic Type R.
The Porsche 959 redefines its 80s performance. Then, test the fun of the Toyota GT86 and Mazda MX-5!
In this track battle, Jaguar F-Type takes on the Porsche 911 while the Morgan Plus 8 takes on the BMW R9T.
Race in the F56 Mini Challenge at Brands Hatch. Then, compare the BMW M4 with the M5.
Dive into Audi Sport's journey in rallying, Quattro revolution and its iconic performance cars.
Explore the groundbreaking RS2 and B5 RS4. Then, Audi Sport transforms rally prowess into road legends!
Join a thrilling Mille Miglia journey in a Bugatti Veyron Vitesse over 1,000 exhilarating miles!
Follow the Aston Martin Valkyrie from Silverstone to Le Mans in a road trip showcasing power and design!
